subject: any simple way to make a legend larger?

messages.author: 5a37f1244321fb07
messages.subject: any simple way to make a legend larger?
parts:
Hello,

I am looking at the documentation for ‘theme’:

 

http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/theme.html

 

And I am wondering whether any easy way to make a legend simply larger, rather than changing it piece by piece (legend.title, legend.text etc..).  In this situation, I also want to make size of symbols (shape in the legend) bigger (proportional to the size change of the legend).

 

So, I am hoping to have something like:

…+ theme (legend=list(size=10, …))

 

But is it possible?

 

Thank you,

Kaori
